title: One-step source comparison
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w$ be a bit string, and suppose the input formed from $n$ and $w$ has edge target $(iv,tv)$. For any oracle $o$ and register values $p,c,a$, one machine step of the edge scan from the source-comparison state with registers $(p,c,a)$ leaves the registers unchanged and moves to the accepting state when $a=iv$, and to the continuation state otherwise.
